 5 more die of dengue, 1,366 hospitalised in a day
 Death toll rises to 357 as total cases reach 1,15,617 
 Published : 20 October 2026
 • 
 Updated : 20 October 2026, 16:50
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 At least five dengue patients died and 1,366 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours till 8:00am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 Of the deaths, two each were reported in Dhaka North City Corporation (DNCC) and Barishal division, while one was reported in Rangpur division.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the latest deaths and cases, the total death toll rose to 357 and the number of cases to 1,15,617.
 Currently, 5,944 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at hospitals across the country.
